story_type: hiker trapped on a sheer sea cliff, swimmer lowered down the face, hoisted together
hook: Stuck on a sheer cliff. The only way off was a cable.
narration: This hiker was stuck on a sheer cliff above the ocean, and the only way off was a cable.
It was March 2026, at God's Thumb in Lincoln City, Oregon. Local firefighters had a high-angle rope team, but they decided they could not reach him safely.
So a Coast Guard helicopter crew from Air Facility Newport lowered their rescue swimmer down the face of the cliff.
The hoist operator guides the cable by hand from the door, keeping the swimmer off the rock.
[short pause] Then the cable came back up, with both of them on it.
outcome: The crew hoisted him safely and flew him to the hospital, and he was reunited with his family.
title: Trapped on a cliff at God's Thumb
description:
On March 14, 2026, a Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin crew from Air Facility Newport hoisted a hiker trapped on a cliff side at God's Thumb in Lincoln City, Oregon, after North Lincoln Fire and Rescue determined its high-angle team could not safely reach him.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Air Facility Newport, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/999764/coast-guard-rescues-hiker-who-trapped-cliff-side-gods-thumb-lincoln-city
